notes: Balanced representative sampler for arena leaderboards: 100 clips per language drawn deterministically (index-strided, not first-N) from MInDS-14 (banking), Speech-MASSIVE (assistant) and FLEURS ca_es/gl_es (read-speech) — 50/50 split when a locale has two sources (de-DE, es-ES, fr-FR, ko-KR, nl-NL, pl-PL, pt-PT, ru-RU) — so a new board can breadth-first cover every registered STT locale before the full per-corpus datasets accrete.
